text:
maria_support: Customer reported invoice total doesn't match dashboard usage after VAT. They say invoice shows +0.02 EUR that isn't in dashboard. raising ticket #8342

alex_billing: got it. customer id and invoice pdf?

maria_support: sent invoice PDF and a CSV export of usage. attaching excerpt: 
```
invoice_line,net_amount,vat, gross
prompt_tokens,12.3456,0.247,12.5926
completion_tokens,7.6544,0.153,7.8074
cache_credit,-0.0012,-0.00002,-0.00122
```
They say our invoice rounds each line to 2 decimals then sums, dashboard sums raw cents then applies VAT at the end. result differs by 0.02 EUR for this invoice.

alex_billing: hm. we have two rounding modes historically: per-request rounding (we round each line to currency precision during line rendering) vs per-invoice rounding (sum full-precision then round final totals). For EU invoices we should be using per-line VAT calculations but need to be consistent with dashboard. cc @jordan_engineer for billing service behavior.

jordan_engineer: I can repro locally. Looks like invoice renderer is applying rounding at the line level (2 decimal places) and also formatting a displayed VAT per-line. dashboard metric `usage_cost_raw` keeps full precision until the invoice job aggregates. quick check of aggregation query we run: 
```sql
SELECT invoice_id, SUM(cost_tokens) as raw_cents FROM token_usage WHERE invoice_id = 'inv_007' GROUP BY invoice_id;
```
But the invoice generator does: 
```py
for line in lines:
    line.net = round(line.net, 2)
    line.vat = round(line.net * vat_rate, 2)
    invoice.total += line.net + line.vat
```
so we do two rounds per-line.

maria_support: customer insists dashboard shows totals that match their internal accounting. They expect invoice math = dashboard math.

alex_billing: what's odd is the delta 0.02 could be from negative micro-line (cache credit) being rounded away. Jordan can we change invoice job to accumulate full-precision sums and only round at the final rendered totals? That might match dashboard.

jordan_engineer: changing to final-rounding is straightforward, but in some jurisdictions tax law expects VAT to be calculated per-line. For EU VAT you're often required to show per-line VAT. Need to confirm legal expectation. Also must check if other customers rely on existing per-line rounding.

billing-bot: Automated check: invoice inv_007: dashboard_total=20.1354 EUR, invoice_display_total=20.15 EUR, delta=0.0146 EUR (rounded to 0.01 on PDF), vat_rate=0.20.

sre_ops: tagging potential regressions: if we change rounding we need to ensure invoice checksum API doesn't break for archived invoices. Also add a migration note.

alex_billing: Proposal: 1) explain to customer difference and show calculation; 2) offer corrected invoice if they prefer per-invoice rounding; 3) evaluate global change or per-region rule.

maria_support: customer asked for a corrected invoice for bookkeeping. can we fast-track a manual override?

jordan_engineer: we can generate a one-off corrected invoice by re-running the invoice renderer in 'final-round' mode. I'll produce a preview and attach. Also will add unit tests: cases with negative micro-credits and mix of prompt/completion tokens.

alex_billing: please include audit note on PDF: "Rounding method: per-line VAT rounding" or "per-invoice rounding" depending on mode. transparency will reduce support churn.

maria_support: agreed. Customer wants CSV with line-level raw values too.

jordan_engineer: sending preview now. Example of the fix SQL for reconciliation: 
```sql
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT invoice_id, SUM(cost_tokens_raw) as net_unrounded, SUM(cost_tokens_raw)*0.20 as vat_unrounded
  FROM token_usage WHERE invoice_id='inv_007' GROUP BY invoice_id
)
SELECT invoice_id, ROUND(net_unrounded,2) as net, ROUND(vat_unrounded,2) as vat, ROUND(net_unrounded+vat_unrounded,2) as total FROM raw;
```
This produces invoice_total matching dashboard_total when we use the same `cost_tokens_raw`.

maria_support: perfect. what's ETA on the manual corrected invoice?

jordan_engineer: I can push a preview in 2 hours, final PDF after review in 1 business day. I'll also open a follow-up to decide default behavior.

alex_billing: thanks. please include note about how microcent negative credits are handled (we should not drop them silently).

maria_support: customer reply: "If you can produce a version that matches our dashboard numbers, we'll accept a credit note if needed. Also please include the raw token counts per request."

jordan_engineer: will include raw CSV and add test case. Also filing bug: BILL-492 "Invoice renderer: per-line rounding causes small mismatches vs dashboard"

alex_billing: moving to post-action: 1) manual corrected invoice sent 2) product/legal to confirm VAT rules per-entity 3) consider feature flag to toggle rounding mode per-customer.

maria_support: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll update customer with ETA and attach preview when available.

billing-bot: Note: reconciliation job scheduled at 2026-03-17T18:00Z to compare invoices vs dashboard usage across EU region, will file anomalies.

maria_support: closing loop here when preview is sent. thanks all.
